items.title: Show HN: The Occult Gatsby
items.titleZh: 显示 HN：神秘的盖茨比
items.summary:
The Occult Great Gatsby
The Great Gatsby Annotated for Esoteric Content:
The Fourth Way, Alchemy, Tarot, and Kabbalah Author is my father, Jon Woodson. I'm the web guy who wanted to bring this to a wider audience with a more interactive way to pop-up the notes about esoteric content. Author's blurb from Amazon self-publishing page: F. Scott Fitzgerald’s novel, The Great Gatsby, is a manual for spiritual development. It is not a unique text, for many American modernist novels of canonical stature are similarly grounded in the occult. Fitzgerald was a follower of A. R. Orage who not only taught the Gurdjieff Work (the Fourth Way) but organized a vast literary network to further its goals. The chief reason that this occult literary tendency has remained in the shadows is that the arbiter of the movement has been poorly understood and critically neglected. The Great Gatsby belongs to a genre of the novel invented by Carl Van Vechten. Van Vechten’s novel, The Blind Bow-Boy (1923) was the model for The Great Gatsby and for many other modern masterpieces. My annotated presentation of Fitzgerald’s novel performs three functions. Since emblematic novels are all written using the same phonetic-syllabic code, the alchemical cabala, I have decoded the novel and presented a running account of the coded subtext in footnotes. The actual texts that have decrypted are presented in italics.

items.summaryZh:
神秘的了不起的盖茨比
《了不起的盖茨比》深奥内容注释：
第四条路，炼金术，塔罗牌和卡巴拉作者是我的父亲乔恩·伍德森。我是一名网络人员，希望通过一种更具互动性的方式来弹出有关深奥内容的注释，从而将其带给更广泛的受众。来自亚马逊自助出版页面的作者简介：F·斯科特·菲茨杰拉德的小说《了不起的盖茨比》是一本精神发展手册。这并不是一部独特的文本，因为许多具有经典地位的美国现代主义小说同样以神秘学为基础。菲茨杰拉德是 A. R. 奥拉奇的追随者，他不仅教授葛吉夫作品（第四条道路），而且组织了一个庞大的文学网络来推进其目标。这种神秘主义文学倾向一直处于阴影之中的主要原因是，人们对这场运动的仲裁者知之甚少，并且严重忽视了这一点。 《了不起的盖茨比》属于卡尔·范·韦希滕发明的小说类型。范·维克滕的小说《盲弓童》（1923 年）是《了不起的盖茨比》和许多其他现代杰作的原型。我对菲茨杰拉德小说的注释呈现具有三个功能。由于象征性小说都是使用相同的音节代码（炼金术秘法）编写的，因此我对小说进行了解码，并在脚注中对编码的潜台词进行了连续说明。已解密的实际文本以斜体显示。
